name: Pre-College Summer Academy, Villanova University
org: Villanova University College of Professional Studies
what_you_do: Take one 3 credit college course with Villanova faculty and a 1 credit College Pathways course. It is a four-week summer program on campus. You can earn four college credits.
who_can_apply: Rising high school juniors and seniors, and incoming college freshmen. Needs a personal statement of 250 to 500 words.
pay_detail: 2026 prices: Residential $8,000 (room and meals). Non-residential $6,000. $2,000 deposit due at acceptance. $50 application fee.
deadline_text: The page says applications for 2027 will close in the spring; no exact closing date is posted. The page says 2027 dates are being finalized, with classes expected in July.
how_to_apply: Apply online, pick the Pre-College Summer Academy choice and pay the fee. Send a personal statement, a two minute video and a writing sample. You also need a letter from a teacher, your school record and a letter from a parent.
notes: The page says that being accepted does not promise acceptance later at Villanova. It also does not give you an edge. The page still shows an old April 6, 2025 date for materials, so ask for the 2027 deadline.
